setup.title: Welcome to cash-bowl
setup.intro: This is the first run: create your account. You will be the administrator and can then create accounts for the rest of the household.

dashboard.title: My month
dashboard.overspent: You are {amount} over what was available. Set aside so far: {saved}.

drafts.one: You have {count} draft to sort out this month: it is not counted in any total.
drafts.other: You have {count} drafts to sort out this month: they are not counted in any total.

dashboard.savedDraft: Draft saved. You will find it under “To sort out”.

entry.privateLabel: Private expense: only you will see it

plan.title: This month's plan
plan.intro: Kakebo starts here: what comes in, what goes out on its own, and how much you want to set aside. Income and fixed costs are always shared.
plan.goalLabel: How much you want to set aside this month

entryEdit.author: Entered by {name}.
entryEdit.draftNotice: This entry is still a draft: it is not counted in any total. Fill in amount, category and date, then press “Save”.

drafts.title: To sort out
drafts.intro: Drafts stay out of every total until they have an amount, a category and a date. That is the point: record on the spot, sort out later.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: The four kakebo categories do not change: they are the method. Under each one you can create the sub-categories you need. A sub-category already in use is not deleted but deactivated, so the history stays readable.

profile.title: My profile
profile.passwordSaved: Password changed. Your other devices will have to sign in again.
profile.reducedMotionHint: Removes transitions. Your phone may already ask for this.

admin.title: Household users
admin.caption: Who can sign in to this installation
admin.name: Name
admin.resetHint: For when a household member has forgotten their password.

errors.adminOnly: This page is for administrators only.
